notes.title: Dev Note #4
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again, this is Taehyun Kim, director of Sudden Attack Zero Point.

Today, we'd like to talk about the weapon customization system, where you can tailor any weapon to fit your combat style.
[/p][h2]\[Our Objective Behind the Weapon Customization System][/h2][p]We believe that one of the core elements that make FPS games enjoyable is selecting which weapon to use in battle.
With that in mind, our development team held many discussions about what kind of system could enhance the fun and satisfaction of that experience.

As a result, we decided to focus our efforts on the "weapon customization" system, where you can assemble your own weapons.

Imagine the thrill of collecting weapon parts one by one and combining them into something that not only looks great but is also uniquely yours.

With the hope that you will enjoy the process of crafting your own weapon, we would now like to introduce the different types of weapon parts and their functions. 
[/p][h2]\[Customizable Weapon Components][/h2][p]From primary weapons to melee weapons, all weapons except the C4 can be customized.
The customizable components for each weapon category are as follows:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="185,"][tr][th colwidth="185"][p]Primary weapons[/p][/th][td][p]Scope, grip, magazine, underbarrel, muzzle, barrel, [/p][p]handguard, stock (8 components)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="185"][p]Secondary weapons[/p][/th][td][p]Scope, grip, magazine, underbarrel, muzzle (5 components)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="185"][p]Melee weapons[/p][/th][td][p]Blade, handle (2 components)[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p](Customizable components may vary by weapon, and we are considering expanding them in the future.)[/p][p]
Every weapon part has unique options, and replacing a part will change the weapon design (3D model) accordingly. 
To further highlight the uniqueness of each weapon, we are also in the process of developing a variety of skins, such as the one shown below.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551505/315c4779c6e96780db89d14677f8ef812985c72b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551505/f0b98bbebf0b2af5b6f3e430c0de87a46ce0673f.png"][/img]※ The skin in the image is still in development and may differ from the final product.[/p][p]
Depending on options of the parts you choose to equip, you can modify your weapon to amplify its strengths or compensate for its weaknesses.

Let's take a look at an example.
One of the fixed options on the underbarrel of KRISS is \[Increased Moving Accuracy].
To take advantage of the KRISS's lightweight design, you can choose this option to maximize its performance.
If you prefer close-range combat and want to improve visibility, removing your scope to clear your line of sight entirely can be your tactic for victory.[/p][p]To reflect each player's personal preferences in weapon design and introduce more diverse gameplay experiences, we are doing our best to expand the range of customizable parts as much as possible. We hope you are as excited as we are about this.
[/p][h2]\[SNF Participation Notice][/h2][p]As we have shared various news with you through the Dev Notes, we have no doubt that many of you are eager to try the game for yourselves.

To present the game to you as early as possible and gather your valuable feedback, we have decided to participate in the Steam Next Fest this coming October.

As this is the first time we'll be introducing this build to a large audience, we are working diligently and testing it every day to ensure everything is thoroughly prepared. 
We look forward to your participation and hope you'll have fun!
(Details on how you can participate will be provided in a future announcement.)

Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Note #3
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again, this is Taehyun Kim, director of Sudden Attack Zero Point. [/p][p]Today's topic is the game modes that we are working on right now, and how the match making systems will work.[/p][p]We sincerely hope you enjoy reading this since it's related to the core game content. 
[/p][h2]\[Focusing on the Bomb Defusal Mode][/h2][p]What is the core game mode of Sudden Attack in your opinion?
We believe it's the Bomb Defusal Mode, Sudden Attack's very first and iconic game mode.

Bomb Defusal Mode delivers the unique game experience of intensiveness, strategic team-play, and the thrill of victory that no other modes can.

This particular game mode has been continuously mentioned frequently even today, so I hope my belief is right- that you feel the same way we do.

While we wish to develop various game modes to present to you at Day One, we have been focused on developing and improving the Bomb Defusal game mode until recently.[/p][p]
We wanted to deliver the quality we all can be proud of, despite the limited resources we have access to at the moment.

There are 3 elements we focused on while developing the Bomb Defusal Mode.
First was keeping familiarity while adopting the recent shooter game trends.
Keeping 3rd Supply Base and Provence's strategic elements and its structural balance while providing upgraded visuals for new gameplay experience wasn't an easy task.

We also made sure enhancing the overall map quality wasn't interfering with visibility.

Second was maintaining Sudden Attack's unique gameplay in the widescreen resolution.
Sudden Attack Zero Point supports widescreen resolution, which can feel like a drastic change to those who experienced Sudden Attack in the past.

We went through extensive evaluations and revisions to make sure we can provide consistent and fair gameplay experience without disrupting the overall game balance.

Third was improving the Bomb Defusal Mode rule to be a more intense experience.
The core change was revising the mode rule, playing BO5 matches two times as defense and offense.
We believe that playing BO5 matches can improve the strategic depth and fairness of the game, while keeping the game intense to the very last moment of the match.

Additionally, since acknowledging the C4 plant area is important to both offense and defense, we have added visual indicators to help players acknowledge the area.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551505/7c62034e8e066aba73d6e6f63613dfb2e52e91b0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551505/10745b454d949d1138941ba037dcd3782445e54e.png"][/img][/p][p]In early July, we conducted a closed beta test in Thailand to evaluate Bomb Defusal Mode's gameplay experience and overall quality of the game.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551505/65af18b3dca0058c6ae9a34ffaa764d2f75c5034.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551505/76622f5cae157f3093b4d39cb4c308336108b73d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551505/8e653c57aec2e415b8609dff0c5274ea20e96179.png"][/img][/p][p]Below are some of the feedback we have received during the test.
[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Feedback from the closed beta test[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p](3rd Supply Base) Bomb Defusal is easier to play as a team and feels more intense compared to TDM.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](3rd Supply Base) The map is more fun, featuring wider open areas and multiple horizontal layers in the map for more dynamic gameplay.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](Provence) The map feels wider than others and having buildings and objects for cover provides chances for strategic play.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](Provence) The wooden gate in the center path was penetrable, adding strategic depth and fun.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](Crossport) The map felt more complex, having many small paths connected to the main path.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p](Crossport) It was fun using smoke screens and flash bangs for tactical plays.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]
We are now improving the overall experience based on the feedback from the test and we are also considering an open beta test to reach a wider audience.

We feel both excited and pressured. We will do our very best to prepare for the open beta test in the near future!

[/p][h2]\[Introducing Match Queue][/h2][p]In Sudden Attack, players created or joined a room to play games.

Such method allowed players to choose the maps and size of the match they wanted to play, allowing more freedom.[/p][p]In a different perspective, players were required to browse through the list of rooms to find a match with the map and size they preferred.[/p][p]Since MMR(Matchmaking Rating) wasn't accounted for, the overall balance of the match wasn't fair, affecting the quality of the match itself.

We understand that lack of match quality directly affects your gameplay experience.[/p][p]In order to provide a quick and fair match environment, we've decided to introduce Match Queue- which will automatically match players with similar skill levels.

Because numerous changes have been made, we want to give you some time to adopt before jumping into a competitive environment.[/p][p]Ranked Match are in development now, so be prepared to prove your skills!

That is all we have for today.[/p][p]Your comments and feedback really mean a lot to us. So don't forget to comment!

For the next Dev Note, we will be talking about weapon customization system, so stay tuned!

Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Note #2
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again, this is Taehyun Kim, the director of [i]Sudden Attack Zero Point[/i].[/p][p]Today, we’d like to talk about why [i]Sudden Attack[/i] has embarked on a new journey named Zero Point.[/p][p]As we mentioned in our previous Dev Note, [i]Sudden Attack[/i]’s unique strengths are its “easy-to-learn” and “fast-paced” gameplay.[/p][p]However, one point of regret was the inability to continue our global service. Learning from that experience though, we’ve reorganized and are ready to take on that challenge once again.[/p][p]Over the past two decades, there have been significant improvements in graphics, and we recognized the need for technical enhancements in order to keep up with the latest trends and remain competitive.[/p][p][/p][p]Therefore, we’d like to show you how our graphics have improved thanks to these technical enhancements.[/p][p][/p][h2][Upgraded Graphics][/h2][p]We’ve redeveloped the Jupiter engine, which is the same engine used for [i]Sudden Attack[/i], allowing it to deliver higher-quality graphics while keeping system requirements low.[/p][p]If our only goal was to provide better graphics, it would’ve been more efficient to switch to the latest engine.[/p][p]But we wanted to preserve the unique feel and gameplay strengths of [i]Sudden Attack[/i], so we focused on improving Zero Point’s graphics with the Jupiter engine as much as possible. [/p][p]While the graphics have been greatly improved, the time it takes to create content is very time-consuming due to limited functionality and compatibility when compared to recent engines.[/p][p]Although we aren’t able to present all the content we want immediately, we are planning on regular and frequent updates after launch to make up for this.[/p][p][/p][h2][Widescreen Resolution Support and FOV Changes][/h2][p]The original [i]Sudden Attack[/i] was developed based on a 4:3 aspect ratio, which led to a forced widescreen resolution on widescreen monitors.[/p][p][i]Sudden Attack Zero Point[/i] will support various resolutions and aspect ratios so that it can be played regardless of monitor type.[/p][p]As we will be supporting various resolutions, the FOV (Field of View) will also be revised based on each player’s screen resolution.[/p][p]We are making various yet precise adjustments in order to preserve [i]Sudden Attack’[/i]s essence.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45551505/f78fbd10912a61934f9852cefd811608c3151b83.gif"][/img][/p][p]In short, these improvements are expected to further enhance the “easy-to-learn” and “fast-paced” gameplay that is synonymous with [i]Sudden Attack[/i]. The team is currently undergoing internal and closed tests to ensure that these improvements provide a better, more enjoyable gameplay experience for all players.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Sudden Attack Zero Point[/i] will continue to adapt to an ever-changing game environment and player expectations. We sincerely hope you’re just as excited about the remastered [i]Sudden Attack[/i] as we are.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Dev Note
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone. My name is Taehyun Kim, director of Sudden Attack and Sudden Attack Zero Point.
Today, we would like to share some information about the background of Sudden Attack Zero Point and the direction we are heading towards to with our players around the globe.

Sudden Attack has always been a beloved game for the team. We believe its easy-to-learn and fast-paced gameplay, intense physical combat, and focus on tactics sets it apart from other games and are what allowed it to become so popular around the world.
 
We deeply regret that in the past release, we weren't able to continue the live service for various reasons.
That is why while preparing the graphics upgrade, we wanted to share the improvements we have made to the players that loved our game.

Sudden Attack Zero Point carries on the gameplay experience of Sudden Attack that has been so beloved for the past 20 years, and at the same time, it is being newly reinterpreted to be enjoyed by players worldwide. Through completely revamped graphics and innovative ideas, we aim to deliver an experience that feels familiar but new at the same time and intuitive at first sight yet rich in depth.
Currently, we are focused on developing the following aspects of the game:
 
[list]
[*] Gameplay that builds on the strengths of the original Sudden Attack
[*] Classic tactical gameplay where strategy and cooperation are essential
[*] Experience creating and mastering your own gameplay style
[/list]
 
Of course, all of these are still under development, and we want to communicate closely with you as we continue to improve the game.
 
Your voice and opinions are invaluable to us; please, feel free to share your thoughts at any time.
We are always listening, and we truly believe that together we can create an even better game.

We would like to sincerely thank you for joining us on this journey.
We look forward to sharing more exciting updates with you in the future.
 
Be sure to follow our official channels to receive the latest news and development updates!
- [url=https://www.facebook.com/suddenattackofficial]Facebook[/url]
- [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Sudden_Attack_Zero_Point]YouTube[/url]
- [url=https://www.instagram.com/playsuddenattack/]Instagram[/url]
- [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@suddenattackzeropoint]TikTok[/url]

We hope to speak to you again soon!
Thank you!
